title: Mini-ITX case
message: A printed case for a Mini-ITX board with a low-profile cooler and a Flex ATX power supply standing beside it. Three printed parts, 3 mm walls, standoffs at the board's four mounting holes, the I/O shield and power inlet open at the back, vents at the front and left, and nothing touching when assembled.
followUps: Move the power supply 10 mm to the right and keep the clearances.
